verdict.rationale: Name.com documents WHOIS privacy protection: there is an API endpoint that enables it on a domain, and privacy appears among the manageable domain settings. Nothing in the evidence shows it is free or on by default. The existence of an explicit 'enable' operation suggests it may need to be turned on rather than applied automatically. Missing for 10: evidence that privacy is free with no upsell, evidence that it is on by default at registration, and detail on which fields (name, address, email) are redacted.
